snippet.title: Mewts Gameplay Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Mewts on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3939660/Mewts/
--
Want to play as something cuter than humans? Play as Mewts! Compete in Football but would you love me if I was a worm. Smash your face into your friends at high speeds! Fight it out in crazy arenas for up to 4 players in a punchable distance or online.
